inputSnapshot.learningGoal: TypeScript discriminated union과 runtime validation을 배우고 싶다

round.generationRationale: Four first-useful directions expose different runtime boundaries without making the learner inspect full evaluation matrices.

diversityCheck.rationale: Configuration editing, webhook replay, form-state simulation and database-row inspection use distinct users, interactions and data shapes.

candidates.title: Safe Config Gate
candidates.summary: Paste a local config and see valid values separated from actionable errors before the app starts.
targetUsers: Developers maintaining small local TypeScript tools
candidates.coreInteraction: Edit one configuration object, validate it, then compare accepted variants with rejected fields.
candidates.usageMoment: Before connecting a changed configuration file to a local tool.
candidates.appeal: Turns an invisible startup failure into an immediate, inspectable gate.
candidates.technologyNecessity: Runtime validation checks unknown config while a discriminated result controls safe success and error branches.

candidates.title: Webhook Replay Desk
candidates.summary: Replay several provider events and inspect which typed handler accepts each payload.
candidates.coreInteraction: Choose a provider event, replay its payload, and trace validation into the matching handler.
candidates.usageMoment: When an integration behaves differently for payment, refund and unknown events.
candidates.appeal: Makes opaque webhook failures reproducible without live credentials.
candidates.technologyNecessity: Unknown JSON must be validated before its event discriminator can select a safe handler.

candidates.title: Form State Theater
candidates.summary: Drive a multi-step form through idle, editing, validating, failed and submitted states.
candidates.coreInteraction: Trigger state transitions and observe which controls and messages are valid in each state.
candidates.usageMoment: While diagnosing impossible UI combinations in a complex form.
candidates.appeal: Impossible states become visible scenes that can be played and fixed.
candidates.technologyNecessity: A discriminated state union prevents invalid combinations and validates restored draft data at runtime.

candidates.title: Database Row Guard
candidates.summary: Inspect nullable query rows and convert them into explicit found, missing and invalid results.
targetUsers: Developers adding a database to a small data app
candidates.coreInteraction: Run a sample query, inspect its raw row, and transform it into one safe result variant.
candidates.usageMoment: Before query data reaches calculations or a user-facing screen.
candidates.appeal: Shows exactly where a loose row becomes dependable application data.
candidates.technologyNecessity: Row validation detects malformed values and a result union makes missing and invalid outcomes explicit.
